page.layout: One printed page. Woodcut ornament at top; title block centred (MEDULLAE / THEOLOGIAE / CHRISTIANAE / LIBER SECUNDUS. / LOCUS DECIMUS SEPTIMUS. / DE / PERSONA JESU CHRISTI.); running head at top above the ornament; then "BREVIARIUM." heading; then one column of italic text with a signature "a" and catchword "13.For-" at the foot right. Faint show-through from the reverse side in the margins, not transcribed. Marginal reference marks appear at the left edge of the text lines but no legible margin note text.

l.i: Jesus Christus heri, hodie, & in secula idem; qualis hodie sit,
deinceps explicandum. 1. Ejus Persona definitur. 2. E-
jus incarnatio fusius demonstratur. 3. Etiam V.T. vati-
ciniis & typis illustratur. 4. Verus Deus & homo est. 5.
Divinam naturam per æternam generationem; humanam
per conceptionem ex Spiritu S. ex B. Virgine habet. 6.
Nasci enim debuit, & natus est ex virgine, sed desponsata,
& perpetua virgine. 7. Sed per conceptionem supernatura-
lem ex Spiritu S. 8. Cujus tres actus fuerunt, formatio,
sanctificatio, & carnis in unitatem personæ assumptio. Forma-
tio non est facta ex semine à Spiritu S. formato, & in uterum
ria. 10. Sed ex substantia solius Mariæ. 11. Fanatico-
rum argumenta diluuntur. 12. Origo carnis Christi ex A-
damo per Davidem ex ejusdem genealogia demonstratur.

page.notes: The running head and page number are printed in faint type above the ornament and are partly obscured; the running head reading is approximate. The text is in italic with long-s and u/v modernised. Show-through text from the reverse page is not transcribed. Several marginal notes at the left and right margins are too faint to read and are omitted.
